items.title: Cybersecurity and Safe Digital Collaboration: Introduction

source_refs.note: Chapter introduction with the Student Learning Outcomes and Figure 9.1 as printed (PDF 122, printed 118).

blocks.text: By the end of this chapter, students will be able to:

items: Identify and apply safe practices when collaborating on digital or online platforms.
Understand of common types of cybersecurity problems and topics such as 2FA, biometric verification, and secure techniques for transmitting data.
Collaborate on creation of digital applications and understand strategies to design for equity and equal access to information.
Explore digital entrepreneurship concepts and develop simple technology-based business ideas using digital platforms and collaborative tools.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book prints "Understand of common types"; it should read "Understand common types" (the word "of" is extra).

In this chapter, students will explore how technology supports safe, secure, and responsible participation in the digital world. They will learn about online safety, cybersecurity, data protection, privacy settings, and secure collaboration using modern digital platforms. The chapter also introduces digital entrepreneurship, innovation, and the skills needed to identify business opportunities and solve real-world problems through technology. Students will explore ethical, legal, social, and environmental aspects of computing, including intellectual property, data privacy, cybersecurity laws, and sustainable computing practices. They will also learn the importance of teamwork, accessibility, digital communication, and responsible use of technology in personal, educational, and professional settings (as shown in Figure 9.1). By the end, students will understand how to use technology safely, responsibly, ethically, effectively, and creatively in daily life and future careers.
